segments.normalizedSource: ```javascript function updateMenuItem(menuItem, url) { var request = new XMLHttpRequest(); request.open("GET", url, true); request.onreadystatechange = function() { if (request.status == 200) { var document = request.responseXML; var menuItemDocument = menuItem.parentNode.getFeature("MenuBarDocument"); menuItemDocument.setDocument(document, menuItem) } }; request.send(); } ```
